exposure: Systolic/diastolic (S/D) ratio of middle cerebral artery
cohort: 100 pregnant women between 32 and 37 weeks gestation with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
finding: An abnormal cerebroplacental ratio was a more reliable predictor of adverse perinatal outcomes in women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy compared to umbilical artery or middle cerebral artery S/D ratios.
